LESSON: KUSOMA 5.2.1 KUSOMA KWA UFAHAMU SHAIRI

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: USHAURI-NASAHA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Ujifunz
Topic 5.2: Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Shairi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Shairi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya shairi ubeti na mshororo ili kuvibainisha
2. kusoma shairi kwa ufasaha kwa kuzingatia ujumbe
3. kutambua beti na mishororo katika shairi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya shairi ubeti na mshororo ili kuvibainisha
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya shairi ubeti na mshororo ili kuvibainisha. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kusoma shairi kwa ufasaha kwa kuzingatia ujumbe
   In simple words: practise until you can kusoma shairi kwa ufasaha kwa kuzingatia ujumbe. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutambua beti na mishororo katika shairi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua beti na mishororo katika shairi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Shairi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Shairi in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Shairi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Shairi.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya shairi ubeti na mshororo ili kuvibainisha

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Shairi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Shairi important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya shairi ubeti na mshororo ili kuvibainisha
2. kusoma shairi kwa ufasaha kwa kuzingatia ujumbe
3. kutambua beti na mishororo katika shairi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
